     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocusNative
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# The canonical native rank-one presentation contract
    10	
    11	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` deliberately leaves the geometric producer fields explicit.
    12	This file fixes the module part of that contract: for a tied cocycle datum `D`, the module is
    13	always `D.nativeModule` and its base-ring comparison is always
    14	`D.nativeModuleKSheafIso`.  The native piece trivializations supply the line-bundle field;
    15	arbitrary-cartesian pushforward base change and the cohomology/rank certificates stay as
    16	explicit obligations.
    17	
    18	The resulting contract is therefore an adapter interface for a future producer, rather than a
    19	second choice of a line bundle.  Its conversion is consumed directly by the public
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` membership theorem below; no unrelated module or untied class can enter
    21	through this bridge, and the adapter itself does not provide the geometric certificates.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    30	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    36	
    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    39	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    40	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    41	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    42	
    43	/-! ## The native adapter contract -/
    44	
    45	/--
    46	A lambda-tied rank-one presentation whose module is canonically the native module of its
    47	cocycle datum.
    48	
    49	The fields after `datum_class` are exactly the remaining producer obligations.  The line-bundle
    50	certificate is derived from the canonical piece trivializations, so a field-level H⁰/H¹
    51	calculation or an unrelated line bundle cannot be silently substituted for the native
    52	evaluation module.
    53	-/
    54	structure PicRankOneNativePresentation
    55	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    56	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    57	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    58	  represents :
    59	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    60	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    61	  datum_class :
    62	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    63	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    64	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    65	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    66	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    67	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    68	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    69	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    70	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app datum.nativeModule)
    71	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    72	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    73	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    74	  h0_rank_one :
    75	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    76	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
    77	
    78	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    79	
    80	variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    81	
    82	/-- Convert the native adapter contract to the existing local-presentation contract.
    83	
    84	The two native bridge fields are inserted definitionally; all other fields are transported
    85	without weakening or adding hypotheses.
    86	-/
    87	noncomputable def toLocalPresentation
    88	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
    89	    PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam :=
    90	  { cover := P.cover
    91	    representative := P.representative
    92	    represents := P.represents
    93	    datum := P.datum
    94	    datum_class := P.datum_class
    95	    module := P.datum.nativeModule
    96	    module_iso := P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso
    97	    line_bundle := P.datum.nativeModule_isLineBundle
    98	    native_pushforward_base_change := P.native_pushforward_base_change
    99	    h1_vanishing := P.h1_vanishing
   100	    h0_finite := P.h0_finite
   101	    h0_projective := P.h0_projective
   102	    h0_rank_one := P.h0_rank_one }
   103	
   104	theorem nonempty_localPresentation
   105	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
   106	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :=
   107	  ⟨P.toLocalPresentation⟩
   108	
   109	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
   110	
   111	/-! ## Immediate rank-one-locus consumer -/
   112	
   113	/--
   114	An arbitrary-affine family of native contracts supplies the existing public rank-one-locus
   115	consumer.  The family is quantified in exactly the same way as
   116	`PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition`; the conversion only canonicalizes the module
   117	choice and does not manufacture any of the remaining geometric certificates.
   118	-/
   119	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations
   120	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   121	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   122	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   123	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
   124	        Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
   125	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
   126	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   127	  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi
   128	  intro A _ _ t
   129	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := h A t
   130	  exact P.nonempty_localPresentation
   131	
   132	end AlgebraicGeometry

    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
    36	-/
    37	
    38	set_option autoImplicit false
    39	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

    42

    44	  CartesianMonoidalCategory

    53	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    54	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    55	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    56	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    57	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    58	
    59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
    60	
    61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
    62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
    63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
    64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
    65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    69	  represents :
    70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    72	  datum_class :
    73	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
    76	  module_iso :
    77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
    78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
    79	  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
    80	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    81	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    86	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)
    87	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    88	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    89	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    90	  h0_rank_one :
    91	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    92	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
    93	
    94	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation

    98	noncomputable local instance presentationModuleSections
    99	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) (U : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens) :
   100	    Module P.cover.Carrier Γ(P.module, U) :=
   101	  Scheme.moduleKSections
   102	    (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))) P.module U
   103	
   104	/-- The canonical `H^0` base-change equivalence attached to a rank-one presentation.
   105	
   106	This is derived from `P.h1_vanishing`; it is not an independently chosen witness. -/
   107	noncomputable def h0BaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   108	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   109	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   110	    B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] (Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B]
   111	      Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=
   112	  P.datum.datumH0BaseChange B
   113	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
   114	
   115	/-- The canonical evaluation map attached to a tied local rank-one presentation. -/
   116	noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
   117	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   118	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
   119	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   120	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶
   121	      P.module :=
   122	  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   123	    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module
   124	
   125	/-! ## Native pushforward base change and evaluation coherence -/
   126	
   127	/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.
   128	
   129	The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally
   130	`(canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module`. -/
   131	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   132	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   133	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   134	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   135	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   136	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   137	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
   138	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   139	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   140	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) := by
   141	  exact @asIso _ _ _ _ ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module)
   142	    (P.native_pushforward_base_change g f' g' sq)
   143	
   144	/-- The native pushforward base-change isomorphism for an affine coefficient extension. -/
   145	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIsoAffine (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   146	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   147	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   148	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   149	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
   150	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   151	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   152	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   153	        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj
   154	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) :=
   155	  P.nativeBaseChangeIso
   156	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   157	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   158	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   159	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))
   160	
   161	/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
   162	cartesian base change. -/
   163	noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   164	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   165	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   166	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   167	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   168	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   169	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   170	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
   171	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
   172	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   173	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   174	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
   175	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
   176	  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   177	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   178	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   179	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
   180	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   181	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
   182	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)
   183	
   184	/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
   185	presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
   186	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   187	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   188	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   189	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   190	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   191	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   192	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   193	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
   194	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   195	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
   196	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
   197	  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   198	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   199	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   200	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).inv).app
   201	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   202	            (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)) ≫
   203	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module) ≫
   204	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   205	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module)) =
   206	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
   207	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   208	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module)
   209	  exact canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel sq P.module
   210	
   211	/-! The affine coefficient-extension spelling of the evaluation/base-change contract.
   212	
   213	This is the consumer-facing specialization for the future zero-locus construction: it keeps
   214	the coefficient ring `B` and `relCurveMap` explicit while retaining the canonical cartesian
   215	square, rather than introducing a second base-change witness. -/
   216	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIsoAffine_hom_evaluation
   217	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   218	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   219	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   220	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso
   221	      (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   222	      (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   223	      (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   224	      (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C
   225	        (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))).hom ≫
   226	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   227	          (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).counit.app
   228	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) =
   229	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).map P.evaluation := by
   230	  exact P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   231	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   232	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   233	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   234	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

   236	/-! ## The datum/native-section/evaluation bridge -/
   237	
   238	/-- The global datum section represented by a degree-zero cohomology class. -/
   239	noncomputable def datumSection (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   240	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :

640	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   641	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) ∧
   642	        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   643	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   644	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   645	          (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
   646	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0
   647	  letI : Module.Finite P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_finite
   648	  letI : Module.Projective P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_projective
   649	  have hfr : Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   650	      (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) = 1 := by
   651	    rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq]
   652	    exact P.h0_rank_one p
   653	  haveI : Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) :=
   654	    Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hfr]; norm_num)
   655	  haveI : Nontrivial (Q ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   656	    (TensorProduct.comm P.cover.Carrier _ _).toEquiv.symm.nontrivial
   657	  obtain ⟨f, hf, y, hy⟩ :=
   658	    Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective p (Q := Q)
   659	      (by infer_instance)
   660	  refine ⟨f, hf, y, ?_, ?_⟩
   661	  · simpa only [Q] using hy
   662	  · exact P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0 y
   663	
   664	/-- The fibrewise-regular local equations cut by a tied local-away datum section.
   665	
   666	The nonvanishing proof is derived by
   667	`sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero`; it is not additional witness data.
   668	Together with `exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator`, this is the immediate local divisor
   669	consumer on the datum side.  Identifying it with the native evaluation zero locus remains
   670	a separate `O`-module base-change contract. -/
   671	noncomputable def baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations
   672	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   673	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   674	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   675	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   676	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   677	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   678	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   679	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :

   741	The proof follows the presentation itself: restrict `lam` to its etale-cover carrier,
   742	identify that class with `representative`, rewrite it as the datum's relative Picard class,
   743	and read the defining degree condition of `lam`. -/
   744	theorem datum_classDeg_baseChange
   745	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   746	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier L]
   747	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L] :
   748	    classDeg L
   749	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   750	        P.datum.cechPicClass) = genus C := by
   751	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   752	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   753	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] L :=
   754	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier L).restrictScalars k
   755	  have hcurve :
   756	      relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L =
   757	        (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi).left := by
   758	    refine congrArg
   759	      (fun f : overSpec k L ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
   760	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   761	  have hpresentation :
   762	      picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 =
   763	        relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   764	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   765	    exact picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   766	      C lam.1 P.cover P.representative P.represents.symm
   767	  calc
   768	    classDeg L
   769	        (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   770	          P.datum.cechPicClass) =
   771	      relPicDeg L
   772	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
   773	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   774	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) :=
   775	      (relPicDeg_relPicMk L _).symm
   776	    _ = relPicDeg L
   777	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   778	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   779	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) := by
   780	      rw [relPicMap_mk, ← hcurve]
   781	      rfl
   782	    _ = relPicDeg L
   783	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   784	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
   785	      rw [P.datum_class]
   786	    _ = degAt
   787	        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   788	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)))
   789	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) :=
   790	      (degAt_relPicToPicEt
   791	        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))
   792	        (Over.overSpecMap psi)).symm
   793	    _ = degAt (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1)
   794	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) := by rw [hpresentation]
   795	    _ = degAt lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota) :=
   796	      degAt_picEtMap (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   797	    _ = genus C := lam.2 L (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota)

   478	      have e₁ := ((relCurveMap C (↥B₀) B).appLE_resHom
   479	        (inf_le_left : cov₀.pieces i ⊓ cov₀.pieces j ⊓ cov₀.pieces l ≤
   480	          cov₀.pieces i ⊓ cov₀.pieces j)
   481	        (hleO i j) (hleO₃ i j l)
   482	        (inf_le_left : covB.pieces i ⊓ covB.pieces j ⊓ covB.pieces l ≤
   483	          covB.pieces i ⊓ covB.pieces j)
   484	        ((û i j : Γ(relCurve C (↥B₀), cov₀.pieces i ⊓ cov₀.pieces j)))).symm
   485	      have e₂ := ((relCurveMap C (↥B₀) B).appLE_resHom
   486	        (gluedInclCoc cov₀.pieces (cov₀.pieces i) j l) (hleO j l) (hleO₃ i j l)
   487	        (gluedInclCoc covB.pieces (covB.pieces i) j l)
   488	        ((û j l : Γ(relCurve C (↥B₀), cov₀.pieces j ⊓ cov₀.pieces l)))).symm
   489	      have e₃ := ((relCurveMap C (↥B₀) B).appLE_resHom
   490	        (gluedInclSnd cov₀.pieces (cov₀.pieces i) j l) (hleO i l) (hleO₃ i j l)
   491	        (gluedInclSnd covB.pieces (covB.pieces i) j l)
   492	        ((û i l : Γ(relCurve C (↥B₀), cov₀.pieces i ⊓ cov₀.pieces l)))).symm
   493	      rw [e₁, e₂, e₃, hcert i j, hcert j l, hcert i l]
   494	      exact coc.mul_res i j l
   495	  -- (12) assembly and the base-change certificate (the subst-safe endgame lemma)
   496	  exact ⟨⟨cov₀, û, hcoc₀⟩,
   497	    baseChange_eq_of_certs ft₀ ft₁ h₀' a₀' h₁' a₁' hpart₀' hpart₁'
   498	      h₀c a₀c h₁c a₁c p₀ p₁ unit coc û hcoc₀ hh₀ ha₀ hh₁ ha₁ hleO hcert⟩
   499	
   500	/-! ## Stage (iii): the engine over the descent stage -/
   501	
   502	/-- A finitely generated subalgebra of a commutative algebra over a field is a
   503	Noetherian ring (Hilbert basis through `Algebra.FiniteType`). -/
   504	theorem _root_.Subalgebra.FG.isNoetherianRing {B₀ : Subalgebra k B} (hfg : B₀.FG) :
   505	    IsNoetherianRing (↥B₀) := by
   506	  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k (↥B₀) := (Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType B₀).mp hfg
   507	  exact Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k (↥B₀)
   508	
   509	/-- **RE-5, engine-ready form** (the DAT-B keystone; worksheet §2.3 step 2): a cocycle
   510	datum over an arbitrary commutative `k`-algebra `B` descends to a finitely generated —
   511	hence **Noetherian** — subalgebra stage `B₀ ⊆ B`, with the base-change certificate.
   512	`datumRigidEngine` fires over the stage verbatim; its output transports along `B₀ → B`
   513	through `datumH0BaseChangeEquiv` and the certificate. -/
   514	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_fg_isNoetherianRing_baseChange_eq [IsAffineHom π]
   515	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) :
   516	    ∃ B₀ : Subalgebra k B, B₀.FG ∧ IsNoetherianRing (↥B₀) ∧
   517	      ∃ D₀ : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (↥B₀) π, D₀.baseChange (B' := B) = D := by
   518	  obtain ⟨B₀, hfg, D₀, hbc⟩ := D.exists_fg_subalgebra_baseChange_eq
   519	  exact ⟨B₀, hfg, hfg.isNoetherianRing, D₀, hbc⟩
   520	
   521	/-- **The classes correspond under `CechPic.map`** (worksheet §3.2, the "consequently"
   522	half): for a descended datum, the class of the given datum on `C_B` is the pullback of
   523	the stage class along the relative-curve comparison — the stage-(1e) naturality
   524	rewritten along the descent certificate. -/
   525	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.descent_cechPicClass [IsAffineHom π]
   526	    {B₀ : Subalgebra k B} {D₀ : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (↥B₀) π}
   527	    {D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π} (hbc : D₀.baseChange (B' := B) = D) :
   528	    D.cechPicClass = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C (↥B₀) B) D₀.cechPicClass := by
   529	  rw [← hbc]
   530	  exact D₀.cechPicClass_baseChange B
   531	
   532	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
   533	-- The sheaf-of-modules instances over the subalgebra stage exceed the default
   534	-- synthesis budget (the standing pattern of the engine files).
   535	/-- **The rigid engine over a descent stage** (stage-(iii) wrapper): for a datum over a
   536	finitely generated stage `B₀ ⊆ B` — e.g. one produced by
   537	`exists_fg_isNoetherianRing_baseChange_eq` — the Noetherian hypothesis of
   538	`datumRigidEngine` is automatic: fibrewise vanishing of `H¹` of the stage pair gives
   539	`H¹(C_{B₀}, F) = 0` and `H⁰(C_{B₀}, F)` finite projective over `B₀`.
   540	
   541	Transport to `B`: with `hH1 := (datum_subsingleton_pairH1 D₀ hπ hfib)`, the abstract
   542	ring-map clause `datumH0BaseChangeEquiv D₀ hH1 B` identifies `B ⊗[B₀] H⁰(D₀.sheaf)`
   543	with the kernel of the base-changed Čech differential of the stage pair, and the
   544	certificate `D₀.baseChange B = D` rewrites every statement about `D` into one about
   545	`D₀.baseChange B`. Threading the kernel onto `H⁰(D.sheaf)` on the nose is DAT-1 stage
   546	(1d-ii) — the recorded seam. -/
   547	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.descentRigidEngine [IsFinite π]
   548	    {B₀ : Subalgebra k B} (hfg : B₀.FG) (D₀ : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (↥B₀) π)
   549	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   550	    (hfib : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (↥B₀),
   551	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D₀).H1 ⊗[↥B₀] p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :
   552	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule D₀.sheaf 1) ∧
   553	      Module.Finite (↥B₀) (Sheaf.HModule D₀.sheaf 0) ∧
   554	      Module.Projective (↥B₀) (Sheaf.HModule D₀.sheaf 0) := by
   555	  haveI : IsNoetherianRing (↥B₀) := hfg.isNoetherianRing
   556	  exact datumRigidEngine D₀ hπ hfib
   557

     9	/-!
    10	# THE RIGID ENGINE FIRES AT GENUS `0` ON A FIBREWISE-TRIVIAL CLASS, OVER A TEST RING
    11	
    12	`Picard/Pic0VanishingFieldTest.lean` closed every **field** instance of the degree-zero
    13	Picard vanishing at genus `0`; `Picard/Pic0VanishingAffineReduction.lean` proved the `∀ T`
    14	binder *is* the `∀` test-ring binder.  What remained was the **ring** case, and the note
    15	released with it priced that as "cohomology and base change, absent from this tree".
    16	
    17	**That price was wrong, and this file is the correction.**  The relevant engine is landed and
    18	is stated over an arbitrary test ring for an arbitrary class:
    19	
    20	* `Cohomology/GluedSheafExtraction.lean:301` — every Čech Picard class on `C_B` is
    21	  `D.cechPicClass` for some `BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π`, at **every** `k`-algebra `B`;
    22	* `Cohomology/GluedSheafEngine.lean:198` — `datumRigidEngine`: from a *fibrewise* `H¹`
    23	  hypothesis, `H¹(C_B, F_D) = 0` and `H⁰(C_B, F_D)` is finite projective over `B`;
    24	* `Cohomology/GluedSheafDatumFibre.lean:169` — the fibrewise hypothesis follows from a
    25	  witness divisor on the fibre curve with vanishing `H¹`;
    26	* `Picard/DivisorDatumRankOne.lean:148` — on the vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` and
    27	  `χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`, the stalk rank of `H⁰` is `1`.
    28	
    29	What nobody had connected is that at **genus `0`** the fibre inputs of that chain are *free*
    30	rather than expensive, and this file proves exactly that.
    31	
    32	## The two results, and why the hypothesis is the cheap one
    33	
    34	The fibre witness is the **zero divisor**.  Its class is `1` (`picClass_zero`) and its sheaf is
    35	the structure sheaf (`moduleKSheafDivisorSheafZeroIso`), whose `H¹` has `K`-dimension
    36	`genus C` at every field extension `K/k` (`finrank_h1_baseField_eq_genus`) — so at genus `0` it
    37	vanishes, at every prime of `B` at once, with no locus, no openness argument and no
    38	spreading-out.  Hence:
    39	
    40	* `subsingleton_h1_residueField_tensor_of_genus_zero` — the engine's `hfib` clause, for **any**
    41	  datum whose fibre classes are trivial;
    42	* `rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one_of_genus_zero` — `H⁰` of stalk rank `1` at every prime,
    43	  i.e. `π_*L` invertible in the rank spelling, with `χ = 1` supplied by `genus C = 0` rather
    44	  than assumed.
    45	
    46	**The hypothesis is fibre-class triviality, not fibre degree.**  That spelling is deliberate
    47	and is not a strengthening in disguise: at genus `0` the two are *equivalent* by the landed
    48	field-level converse (`eq_one_of_classDeg_eq_zero_of_chi_one`), and
    49	`fibre_cechPicClass_eq_one_of_classDeg_eq_zero` below is that equivalence at this site.  The
    50	reason to state the theorems on triviality is mechanical, and worth recording because it will
    51	bite the next lane: `classDeg K` carries five instance binders on the fibre curve
    52	(`IsIntegral`, `SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1`, `QuasiCompact`, and both `Module.Finite`
    53	Betti-number clauses) which do not synthesize through the `relCurve` `def` barrier, so a
    54	hypothesis phrased `∀ p, classDeg κ(p) … = 0` **cannot be stated** at a general prime without
    55	`haveI`-installing them first — measured, not guessed.  Triviality of the class needs none of
    56	them.
    57	
    58	## What this does NOT do
    59	
    60	* **It does not discharge the `pic⁰` vanishing at a test ring.**  It supplies the two
    61	  cohomological outputs — `H¹ = 0` and `H⁰` invertible — that the classical proof consumes
    62	  next through the evaluation map `π^*π_*L → L`.
    63	
    64	  **CORRECTED after a fresh-context audit (`I-1651`).**  An earlier version of this bullet said
    65	  that map "does not exist in this tree, in the sibling project, or in mathlib (measured this
    66	  session)".  **The mathlib half was false and unmeasured**: the map is the counit of
    67	  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction`
    68	  (`Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Sheaf.lean`), and the sibling project applies
    69	  `.counit.app` to it in two files.  What is genuinely absent is any theorem saying that counit
    70	  is an **isomorphism** at a sheaf of this kind — that is the real residue, and it is a
    71	  narrower and more defensible claim than the one this bullet used to make.  AJCR's own
    72	  carriers are `Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (ModuleCat R)`, not `Scheme.Modules`, so
    73	  reaching the counit here is itself a port.
    74	* **It says nothing at positive genus**, where the fibre `H¹` is genuinely nonzero and the
    75	  witness above fails at the first step.
    76	* It introduces **no hypothesis on the curve** beyond the three standing binders and
    77	  `genus C = 0`, and no hypothesis on the test ring beyond `IsNoetherianRing` — which
    78	  `Cohomology/DatumDescent.lean:547` is designed to remove and which a consumer should remove
    79	  through that route rather than by re-proving anything here.
    80	
    81	## Main declarations
    82	
    83	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.subsingleton_h1_residueField_tensor_of_genus_zero`
    84	  — **the engine's fibrewise hypothesis, free at genus `0`**.
    85	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rigidEngine_of_genus_zero` — the engine's three
    86	  conclusions with the fibrewise clause discharged.
    87	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one_of_genus_zero` —
    88	  **`H⁰` of stalk rank `1`**, at every prime.
    89	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.fibre_cechPicClass_eq_one_of_classDeg_eq_zero` — the
    90	  degree-`0` spelling of the hypothesis implies the triviality spelling, so nothing is lost by
    91	  stating the results on the latter.
    92	-/

    98	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TensorProduct
    99	
   100	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
   101	
   102	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   103	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   104	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   105	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
   106	
   107	noncomputable section
   108	
   109	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   110	
   111	/-! ## The fibre inputs at genus `0` -/
   112	
   113	/-- **`H¹` of the structure sheaf of the fibre curve vanishes at genus `0`**, at every field
   114	extension of the base.
   115	
   116	`finrank_h1_baseField_eq_genus` computes that dimension as `genus C` on the nose, so this is
   117	the hypothesis read as a dimension count; the `Module.Free` instance the `finrank` criterion
   118	wants is the vector-space one. -/
   119	theorem subsingleton_h1_moduleKSheaf_baseChange_of_genus_zero (hg : genus C = 0)
   120	    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] :
   121	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.moduleKSheaf K) 1) := by
   122	  have h : Module.finrank K
   123	      (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.moduleKSheaf K) 1) = genus C :=
   124	    finrank_h1_baseField_eq_genus C K
   125	  rw [hg] at h
   126	  exact (Module.finrank_eq_zero_iff_of_free _ _).mp h
   127	
   128	/-- **The zero divisor is a vanishing witness at genus `0`**: `H¹(𝒪(0)) = H¹(𝒪) = 0`.
   129	
   130	`moduleKSheafDivisorSheafZeroIso` is the identification of the two sheaves; the transport is
   131	`Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv`. -/
   132	theorem subsingleton_h1_divisorSheaf_zero_of_genus_zero (hg : genus C = 0)
   133	    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] :
   134	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.divisorSheaf K
   135	      (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.CurveDivisor)) 1) :=
   136	  (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv (Scheme.moduleKSheafDivisorSheafZeroIso
   137	    (X := (C ⊗ overSpec k K).left) K) 1).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp
   138	      (subsingleton_h1_moduleKSheaf_baseChange_of_genus_zero hg K)
   139	
   140	/-- **THE ENGINE'S FIBREWISE HYPOTHESIS, FREE AT GENUS `0`**: for a datum whose fibre class at
   141	the prime `p` is trivial, the complex-form clause `hfib p` of `datumRigidEngine` holds.
   142	
   143	The witness fed to `subsingleton_h1_residueField_tensor_of_witness` is the **zero divisor**:
   144	its class is `1` by `picClass_zero`, which is the fibre class by hypothesis, and its `H¹`
   145	vanishes by the lemma above.  No locus, no openness, no spreading-out, and the argument is
   146	uniform in `p`. -/
   147	theorem subsingleton_h1_residueField_tensor_of_genus_zero
   148	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) (hg : genus C = 0) (p : PrimeSpectrum B)
   149	    (htriv : (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = 1) :
   150	    Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
   151	  refine D.subsingleton_h1_residueField_tensor_of_witness p ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
   152	  · rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero, htriv]
   153	    rfl
   154	  · exact subsingleton_h1_divisorSheaf_zero_of_genus_zero hg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   155	
   156	/-! ## The engine, and the rank-`1` export -/
   157	
   158	/-- **The rigid engine at genus `0` on a fibrewise-trivial class**: `H¹(C_B, F_D) = 0` and
   159	`H⁰(C_B, F_D)` finite projective over `B`, with the fibrewise clause discharged by the
   160	genus hypothesis rather than assumed. -/
   161	theorem rigidEngine_of_genus_zero (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) [IsNoetherianRing B]
   162	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) (hg : genus C = 0)
   163	    (htriv : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B,
   164	      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = 1) :
   165	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 1) ∧
   166	      Module.Finite B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ∧
   167	      Module.Projective B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) :=
   168	  datumRigidEngine D hπ fun p =>
   169	    D.subsingleton_h1_residueField_tensor_of_genus_zero hg p (htriv p)
   170	
   171	/-- **`H⁰` HAS STALK RANK `1` AT EVERY PRIME** — `π_*L` invertible, in the rank spelling, for a
   172	fibrewise-trivial class on a genus-`0` curve over an arbitrary Noetherian test ring.
   173	
   174	`rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one` is applied at `n := 0`: its χ-normalization
   175	`χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n` is `χ = 1`, which `chi_moduleKSheaf` plus `genus C = 0` supplies, and its
   176	fibre-degree clause is `classDeg κ(p) 1 = 0`, which is `classDeg_one`.  The five fibre
   177	instances are installed by hand — they do not synthesize through the `relCurve` `def`
   178	barrier. -/
   179	theorem rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one_of_genus_zero
   180	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) [IsNoetherianRing B]
   181	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) (hg : genus C = 0)
   182	    (htriv : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B,
   183	      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = 1)
   184	    (p : PrimeSpectrum B) :
   185	    Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
   186	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   187	    instIsIntegralBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   188	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   189	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=
   190	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   191	  haveI : QuasiCompact
   192	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=
   193	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   194	  haveI : Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField (Sheaf.HModule
   195	      ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0) :=
   196	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   197	  haveI : Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField (Sheaf.HModule
   198	      ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1) :=
   199	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   200	  refine D.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one (n := 0) hπ ?_
   201	    (fun q => D.subsingleton_h1_residueField_tensor_of_genus_zero hg q (htriv q)) p ?_
   202	  · rw [chi_moduleKSheaf C, hg]
   203	  · rw [htriv p, Nat.cast_zero]
   204	    exact classDeg_one _
   205	
   206	/-! ## The degree spelling is the same hypothesis at genus `0` -/
   207	
   208	/-- **The degree-`0` spelling implies the triviality spelling**, at genus `0`: a fibre class of
   209	degree `0` *is* trivial, by the landed field-level converse
   210	`eq_one_of_classDeg_eq_zero_of_chi_one` at `χ = 1`.
   211	
   212	So the theorems above lose no generality by taking triviality as the hypothesis; what they
   213	gain is that the hypothesis is statable without the five fibre instances `classDeg` needs.
   214	Consumers holding a degree hypothesis at a prime pass through here. -/
   215	theorem fibre_cechPicClass_eq_one_of_classDeg_eq_zero
   216	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) (hg : genus C = 0) (p : PrimeSpectrum B)
   217	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField)]
   218	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   219	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   220	    [QuasiCompact
   221	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   222	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField (Sheaf.HModule
   223	      ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0)]
   224	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField (Sheaf.HModule
   225	      ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1)]
   226	    (hdeg : classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   227	      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = 0) :
   228	    (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = 1 :=
   229	  eq_one_of_classDeg_eq_zero_of_chi_one p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   230	    (chi_moduleKSheaf_baseChange_eq_one_of_genus_zero C p.asIdeal.ResidueField hg) _ hdeg
   231	
   232	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

    11	/-!
    12	# DAT-C C2 — the rank-1 H⁰ export and the generator kit
    13	(`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` GAP-3 Σ-RANK1, §2 (N1)/(N3))
    14	
    15	On the fibrewise h¹-vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` with the base χ-normalization
    16	`χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`, the datum engine's `H⁰` is an **invertible** module: finite,
    17	projective, and of stalk-rank exactly `1`.  This is the rank export the engine
    18	(`datumRigidEngine`, `Cohomology/GluedSheafEngine.lean`) leaves open — it delivers
    19	finite + projective, never `rankAtStalk = 1`.
    20	
    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chi_relCurve` — the χ transport `χ(𝒪_{C_L}) = 1 − n` to every
    22	  field `L` of the test tower (base-field invariance of the genus, `chi_moduleKSheaf`
    23	  + `genus_baseField`; a re-derivation of the private lemma of `DivSchemeMonoBridgeRel`).
    24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one` — **the fibre
    25	  computation**: for a datum whose fibre class over `L` has `classDeg = n`, with `H¹` of
    26	  the base-changed sheaf vanishing, `h⁰(C_L, F_{D_L}) = 1` — the Riemann–Roch anchor
    27	  `h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` (`n + (1 − n)`) read through the presentation
    28	  bridge `presentationSheafIso`.  The fibre geometric package is threaded as instance
    29	  arguments (`Curve.BaseChangeInstances`).
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one` — **Σ-RANK1,
    31	  the datum-level export**: on the vanishing locus (fibre degree `n`, `χ = 1 − n`),
    32	  `Module.rankAtStalk (H⁰(F_D)) p = 1`.  Route: `Module.rankAtStalk_eq` reads the rank as
    33	  the `κ(p)`-fibre dimension; `datumH0BaseChange` (on the nose) identifies the fibre with
    34	  `H⁰(C_{κ(p)}, F_{D_{κ(p)}})`; the fibre computation above pins it at `1`.
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one` — the
    36	  certified-family specialization (**N1**): for `G` landing in the h¹-vanishing locus
    37	  `V`, the divisor datum `D_G := G.adaptation.divisorDatum` has invertible `H⁰`.  The
    38	  fibre-degree hypothesis is discharged uniformly by `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass` (the
    39	  fibre class has `classDeg = n` at every field).
    40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.exists_fibrewise_generator_divisorDatum`
    41	  — **N3, the generator kit**: since `H⁰(F_{D_G})` is projective of rank `1` (hence has a
    42	  nontrivial fibre at every prime of the locus), a fibrewise-nonzero **global** section
    43	  exists Zariski-locally (`Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective`).
    44	
    45	Noetherian discipline (worksheet §2): every rank statement carries `[IsNoetherianRing S]`
    46	through the engine; the arbitrary-test consumers reach it through RE-5 stages.
    47	-/

    80	/-- **`χ(𝒪) = 1 − n` at every field extension**, from the base normalization
    81	(`chi_moduleKSheaf` at the base-changed bundle + `genus_baseField`; a re-derivation of the
    82	`DivSchemeMonoBridgeRel` private lemma). -/
    83	theorem chi_relCurve (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
    84	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    85	    Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) = 1 - (n : ℤ) := by
    86	  haveI : IsProper (baseChangeBundle C L).hom := instIsProperSndLeft C L
    87	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    88	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft C L
    89	  haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    90	    instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft C L
    91	  have h1 : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L)
    92	      = 1 - (genus (baseChangeBundle C L) : ℤ) := chi_moduleKSheaf (baseChangeBundle C L)
    93	  have h2 : genus (baseChangeBundle C L) = genus C := genus_baseField C L
    94	  have h3 : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (genus C : ℤ) := chi_moduleKSheaf C
    95	  have h4 : (genus C : ℤ) = (n : ℤ) := by rw [h3] at hχ; linarith
    96	  rw [h1, h2, h4]

    98	/-! ## The fibre computation: `h⁰(C_L, F_{D_L}) = 1`
    99	
   100	The fibre geometric instances (`Curve.BaseChangeInstances`) are threaded as instance
   101	arguments — they cannot be synthesized through the `relCurve` `def` barrier, so consumers
   102	install them by `haveI` (the `degAt_abelDiv` block, I-0249 (iv)) before calling. -/
   103	
   104	/-- **The fibre h⁰ pin**: for a datum whose fibre class over the field `L` has
   105	`classDeg = n`, with the base χ-normalization and vanishing `H¹` of the base-changed
   106	sheaf, the fibre global-section count is exactly `1` — the Riemann–Roch rank anchor
   107	`h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` read through the presentation bridge
   108	`presentationSheafIso`, at `n + (1 − n)`. -/
   109	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one
   110	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S π)
   111	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   112	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra S L] [IsScalarTower k S L]
   113	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C L)]
   114	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
   115	    [QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
   116	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0)]
   117	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1)]
   118	    (hg : classDeg L (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ))
   119	    (hsub : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange L).sheaf 1)) :
   120	    Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = 1 := by
   121	  set P : (relCurve C L).MeromorphicPresentation :=
   122	    Scheme.MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle (D.baseChange L).pointedCover
   123	      (gluedSubordCocycle (D.baseChange L).isGluingCocycle
   124	        (D.baseChange L).pointedCover (D.baseChange L).pieceIndex
   125	        fun _ => le_rfl) with hP
   126	  have hsubP : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (P.gluedSheaf L) 1) :=
   127	    (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv (presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L)) 1).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp
   128	      hsub
   129	  have h0eq : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = Sheaf.h0 (P.gluedSheaf L) :=
   130	    Sheaf.h0_congr (presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L))
   131	  have hformula := h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi L P hsubP
   132	  have hPclass : P.picClass = (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass := rfl
   133	  have hint : (Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf : ℤ) = 1 := by
   134	    rw [h0eq, hformula, hPclass, hg, chi_relCurve hχ L]; ring
   135	  exact_mod_cast hint

   138	
   139	/-- **Σ-RANK1, the datum-level rank export** (worksheet GAP-3): on the fibrewise
   140	h¹-vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` with the base χ-normalization `χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`,
   141	the datum engine's `H⁰` has stalk-rank exactly `1` at `p`.
   142	
   143	`Module.rankAtStalk_eq` reads the rank as the `κ(p)`-dimension of the fibre
   144	`κ(p) ⊗[S] H⁰`; the on-the-nose base change `datumH0BaseChange` identifies this fibre with
   145	`H⁰(C_{κ(p)}, F_{D_{κ(p)}})`, whose dimension is `1` by the fibre computation. The global
   146	fibrewise hypothesis `hfib` supplies finiteness/projectivity (hence flatness) through
   147	`datumRigidEngine`. -/
   148	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one
   149	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S π) [IsNoetherianRing S]
   150	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   151	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   152	    (hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
   153	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField))
   154	    (p : PrimeSpectrum S)
   155	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField)]
   156	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   157	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   158	    [QuasiCompact
   159	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   160	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   161	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0)]
   162	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   163	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1)]
   164	    (hg : classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   165	      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ)) :
   166	    Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
   167	  obtain ⟨-, hfin, hproj⟩ := datumRigidEngine D hπ hfib
   168	  haveI := hfin
   169	  haveI := hproj
   170	  have hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1 := datum_subsingleton_pairH1 D hπ hfib
   171	  have hfibre : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf = 1 :=
   172	    D.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one hχ p.asIdeal.ResidueField hg
   173	      (D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1)
   174	  calc Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p
   175	      = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   176	          (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)) :=
   177	        Module.rankAtStalk_eq p
   178	    _ = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   179	          (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf 0) :=
   180	        (D.datumH0BaseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1).finrank_eq
   181	    _ = Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf := rfl
   182	    _ = 1 := hfibre

   187	/-- (Implementation) The fibre class of the divisor datum has `classDeg = n` at `κ(p)`:
   188	the base change of `G.eqns`, read through `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass`. -/
   189	private theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.classDeg_baseChange_divisorDatum
   190	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C S π n) (p : PrimeSpectrum S)
   191	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField)]
   192	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   193	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   194	    [QuasiCompact
   195	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   196	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   197	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0)]
   198	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   199	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1)] :

   201	      (G.adaptation.divisorDatum.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ) := by
   202	  have hcl : G.adaptation.divisorDatum.cechPicClass = (DivFam.mk G).toZar.picClass := by
   203	    rw [G.adaptation.cechPicClass_divisorDatum, DivFamZar.picClass_toZar, DivFam.picClass_mk]
   204	  rw [G.adaptation.divisorDatum.cechPicClass_baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField, hcl,
   205	    ← DivFamZar.picClass_mapAlg]
   206	  exact DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass
   207	    (DivFamZar.mapAlg p.asIdeal.ResidueField n (DivFam.mk G).toZar)
   208	
   209	/-- **N1 — invertibility of the canonical `H⁰`** (worksheet §2 (N1)): for a certified
   210	divisor family `G` landing in the h¹-vanishing locus `V` (`hvan`), the divisor datum
   211	`D_G := G.adaptation.divisorDatum` has `H⁰` of stalk-rank exactly `1` at every prime.
   212	
   213	The fibre-degree hypothesis of `rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one` is discharged uniformly:
   214	the fibre class of `D_G` at `κ(p)` is the base change of `G.eqns`, which has
   215	`classDeg = n` at every field (`DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass`). -/
   216	theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one
   217	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C S π n) [IsNoetherianRing S]
   218	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   219	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   220	    (hvan : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S, (DivFam.mk G).toZar.IsH1VanishingAt p)
   221	    (p : PrimeSpectrum S) :
   222	    Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
   223	  have hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
   224	      Subsingleton ((datumPair G.adaptation.divisorDatum).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   225	    fun q => (G.isH1VanishingAt_toZar_iff q).mp (hvan q)
   226	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   227	    instIsIntegralBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   228	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   229	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=
   230	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   231	  haveI : QuasiCompact
   232	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=
   233	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   234	  haveI : Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   235	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0) :=
   236	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   237	  haveI : Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   238	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1) :=
   239	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   240	  exact G.adaptation.divisorDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one hπ hχ hfib p
   241	    (G.classDeg_baseChange_divisorDatum p)
   242	
   243	/-- **N3 — the generator kit** (worksheet §2 (N3)): since `H⁰(F_{D_G})` is projective of
   244	stalk-rank `1` on the locus, its `κ(p)`-fibre is nontrivial, so a fibrewise-nonzero

   246	(`Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective`, the Nakayama-neighbourhood kit of
   247	`Picard/LocalGenerators.lean`). -/
   248	theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.exists_fibrewise_generator_divisorDatum
   249	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C S π n) [IsNoetherianRing S]
   250	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   251	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   252	    (hvan : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S, (DivFam.mk G).toZar.IsH1VanishingAt p)
   253	    (p : PrimeSpectrum S) :
   254	    ∃ f : S, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∃ q : Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0,
   255	      ∀ q' : PrimeSpectrum S, f ∉ q'.asIdeal →
   256	        (q ⊗ₜ (1 : q'.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   257	            Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0 ⊗[S] q'.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 := by
   258	  have hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
   259	      Subsingleton ((datumPair G.adaptation.divisorDatum).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   260	    fun q => (G.isH1VanishingAt_toZar_iff q).mp (hvan q)

   262	  haveI := hfin
   263	  haveI := hproj
   264	  have hrank : Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) p = 1 :=
   265	    G.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one hπ hχ hvan p
   266	  -- rank 1 ⟹ the `κ(p)`-fibre is nontrivial
   267	  have hfr : Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   268	      (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S] Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) = 1 := by
   269	    rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq]; exact hrank
   270	  haveI : Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S]
   271	      Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) :=
   272	    Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hfr]; norm_num)
   273	  have hnt : Nontrivial (Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0 ⊗[S]
   274	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   275	    (TensorProduct.comm S _ _).toEquiv.symm.nontrivial
   276	  exact Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective p hnt

    11	
    12	The on-the-nose base-change export of the m-chart glued constructor's engine, mirroring the
    13	2-chart `relTwistH0BaseChange` (`RigidEngine4BaseChange`). The abstract kernel clause
    14	`datumH0BaseChangeEquiv` (`GluedSheafEngine`) is threaded through the stage-(1d-ii) chart-term
    15	identifications `termBaseChange`/`termBaseChange_tmul` (`GluedSheafTermBaseChangeEquiv`) onto
    16	`H⁰` of the base-changed datum sheaf.
    17	
    18	* `termBaseChange₀`/`termBaseChange₁`/`termBaseChangeInf` — the chart-term base changes at the
    19	  two pinned charts and their overlap.
    20	* `datumDomBaseChange` — the base change of the two-cover degree-zero term
    21	  `F(V₀ᴮ) × F(V₁ᴮ)`.
    22	* `datumDiffBaseChange` — **the δ-naturality square** (the glued analogue of
    23	  `relTwistDiffBaseChange`; no cocycle conjugation — the componentwise restrictions commute
    24	  with `sectionsMap` through `gluedRes_sectionsMap`).
    25	* `datumH0BaseChange` — **`H⁰` base change on the nose**:
    26	  `B' ⊗[B] H⁰(C_B, F_D) ≃ₗ[B'] H⁰(C_{B'}, F_{D'})` on the vanishing locus, for every ring map
    27	  `B → B'` (`D' = D.baseChange B'`) — the on-the-nose form RE-5's DAT-B route consumes.
    28	* `datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange` — **`H¹` vanishes after base change** on the vanishing
    29	  locus.

    57	/-- The chart-term base change at the pinned chart `V₀ᴮ`. -/
    58	noncomputable def termBaseChange₀ :
    59	    B' ⊗[B] (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ≃ₗ[B']
    60	      ((D.baseChange B').sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) := by
    61	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn D.sheaf

   158	/-- The base change of the two-cover degree-zero term `F(V₀ᴮ) × F(V₁ᴮ)`. -/
   159	noncomputable def datumDomBaseChange :
   160	    B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   161	        (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) ≃ₗ[B']
   162	      ((D.baseChange B').sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   163	        ((D.baseChange B').sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) :=
   164	  (TensorProduct.prodRight B B' B' _ _).trans
   165	    ((D.termBaseChange₀ B').prodCongr (D.termBaseChange₁ B'))
   166	
   167	/-- The degree-zero term base change on a pure tensor. -/
   168	lemma datumDomBaseChange_tmul (b' : B')
   169	    (p : (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   170	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) :
   171	    D.datumDomBaseChange B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p) =
   172	      (D.termBaseChange₀ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p.1), D.termBaseChange₁ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p.2)) := by
   173	  rw [datumDomBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, TensorProduct.prodRight_tmul]
   174	  rfl
   175	
   176	set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
   177	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   178	/-- **The δ-naturality square** (the glued analogue of `relTwistDiffBaseChange`): the base
   179	change of the datum's Čech differential over `B` is carried to the datum's Čech differential
   180	over `B'` under the term identifications. There is no cocycle conjugation — the componentwise
   181	restrictions commute with `sectionsMap` through `gluedRes_sectionsMap`. -/
   182	theorem datumDiffBaseChange
   183	    (x : B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   184	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)))) :
   185	    D.termBaseChangeInf B' (((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' x) =
   186	      (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff (D.datumDomBaseChange B' x) := by
   187	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   188	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
   189	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
   190	  | tmul b' p =>
   191	    have hbc : ((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p) =
   192	        b' ⊗ₜ[B] (datumPair D).diff p := LinearMap.baseChange_tmul _ _ _
   193	    rw [hbc]
   194	    simp only [D.datumDomBaseChange_tmul B', TwoLatticePair.diff_apply,
   195	      D.termBaseChange₀_tmul B', D.termBaseChange₁_tmul B']
   196	    rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, map_sub, D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B',
   197	      D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B', map_smul, map_smul]
   198	    congr 1
   199	    · congr 1
   200	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   201	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   202	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   203	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₀)
   204	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   205	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   206	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   207	        p.1).symm
   208	    · congr 1
   209	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   210	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   211	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   212	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₁)
   213	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   214	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   215	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   216	        p.2).symm

   218	/-! ## The on-the-nose H⁰ base change and H¹ vanishing -/
   219	
   220	open AlgebraicJacobian
   221	
   222	/-- **`H⁰` base change on the nose** (DAT-1 (1d-ii) tail; the RE-5/DAT-B transport interface):
   223	on the vanishing locus, for every ring map `B → B'`,
   224	
   225	`B' ⊗[B] H⁰(C_B, F_D) ≃ₗ[B'] H⁰(C_{B'}, F_{D'})`
   226	
   227	with `D' = D.baseChange B'` — the abstract kernel clause `datumH0BaseChangeEquiv` threaded
   228	through the term identifications by the δ-naturality square `datumDiffBaseChange`. -/
   229	noncomputable def datumH0BaseChange (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
   230	    B' ⊗[B] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B']
   231	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 :=
   232	  (datumH0BaseChangeEquiv D hH1 B').trans
   233	    ((RigidEngine.kerCongr ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B')
   234	        ((datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff)
   235	        (D.datumDomBaseChange B') (D.termBaseChangeInf B')
   236	        (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange B' x)).trans
   237	      ((D.baseChange B').pairData.h0Equiv
   238	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   239	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   240	        (relCover_sup C B' (fiberTwoCover π))).symm)
   241	
   242	/-- **`H¹` vanishes after base change** on the vanishing locus: the base-changed Čech
   243	differential is surjective (right-exactness of `B' ⊗[B] -` plus the δ-square), so `H¹` of the
   244	base-changed datum sheaf vanishes. -/
   245	theorem datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
   246	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 1) := by
   247	  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (datumPair D).diff :=
   248	    D.pairData.surjective_diff (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   249	      (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π)) hH1
   250	  have hbc : Function.Surjective ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B') := by
   251	    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
   252	    exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective B' hsurj
   253	  have hsurj' : Function.Surjective (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff :=
   254	    RigidEngine.surjective_congr _ _ (D.datumDomBaseChange B') (D.termBaseChangeInf B')
   255	      (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange B' x) hbc
   256	  haveI : Subsingleton (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).H1 := by
   257	    have h : (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).imageLattice = ⊤ := by
   258	      rw [← (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).range_diff_eq, LinearMap.range_eq_top]
   259	      exact hsurj'
   260	    rw [TwoLatticePair.H1, h]
   261	    infer_instance
   262	  exact ((D.baseChange B').pairData.h1Equiv
   263	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   264	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   265	    (relCover_sup C B' (fiberTwoCover π))).toEquiv.subsingleton
   266

     9	/-!
    10	# The rigid engine fired on the pinned cocycle datum (DAT-1, stage 1d-i, the engine)
    11	
    12	The keystones of `informal/spec-dat-1.md` stage (1d-i): the abstract rigid engine of
    13	`RigidEngine4Assembly`, fired on the glued sheaf of a pinned basic-open cocycle datum
    14	`D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π` (worksheet §3.2) through the pair data
    15	`D.pairData` — the m-chart mirror of `RigidEngine4Engine`, with every hypothesis
    16	discharged from the landed inputs:
    17	
    18	* the `AEval'` chart finiteness through the stage-(1c) transitivity
    19	  `moduleFinite_aeval'_glued` and the relative E-i
    20	  (`moduleFinite_aeval'_mulSectionEnd_relFiberCoord₀/₁`) —
    21	  `moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₀/t₁`;
    22	* projectivity of the three section modules over `B` through the stage-(1c) transport
    23	  `projective_glued_of_free` and the freeness of the relative chart rings
    24	  (`free_relSections`) — `projective_sections₀/₁/Inf`; the datum's trivializing
    25	  families serve the two pinned charts, and side-0's family restricted along
    26	  `V₀ᴮ ⊓ V₁ᴮ ≤ V₀ᴮ` serves the overlap (the partition witness restricts:
    27	  `BasicOpenCoverData.partitionInf`).
    28	
    29	## Keystones
    30	
    31	* `datumRigidEngine` — **Kleiman 3.10 (v)⟹(i)+(iii), curve-lite, on the datum**: under
    32	  the complex-form fibrewise-vanishing hypothesis, `H¹(C_B, F_D) = 0` and
    33	  `H⁰(C_B, F_D)` is a finite projective `B`-module.
    34	* `datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing` — the strata openness export (Noetherian-free).
    35	* `datumH0TensorEquiv` — the module-coefficient clause (Kleiman `eq:Q`).
    36	* `datumH0BaseChangeEquiv` — the ring-map clause, abstract kernel form (the
    37	  on-the-nose threading onto `H⁰` of the base-changed sheaf is stage (1d-ii)).
    38	* `datum_subsingleton_pairH1` — the fibre form ⟹ pair form wrapper.
    39	
    40	**Staging note (worksheet §3.2, BINDING).** The fibre hypothesis `hfib` is consumed in
    41	COMPLEX form (`Subsingleton (H¹(pair) ⊗ κ(p))`); its sheaf-level discharge gates on the
    42	W6-full seam (DAT-3) and is deliberately NOT attempted here.
    43	-/

   106	`moduleFinite_aeval'_glued`. -/
   107	theorem moduleFinite_aeval'_pair_t₀ (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) :
   108	    Module.Finite (Polynomial B) (Module.AEval'
   109	      ((D.pairData.pair (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π))

   113	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π)) D.isGluingCocycle
   114	    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) (σ := Sum.inl) (h := D.h₀) (fun _ => le_rfl)
   115	    D.span_range_h₀ (relFiberCoord₀ C B π) hA
   116	    ((D.pairData.pair (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π))

   233	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField

   235	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0) :=
   236	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   237	  haveI : Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   238	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1) :=
   239	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   240	  exact G.adaptation.divisorDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one hπ hχ hfib p
   241	    (G.classDeg_baseChange_divisorDatum p)
   242	
   243	/-- **N3 — the generator kit** (worksheet §2 (N3)): since `H⁰(F_{D_G})` is projective of
   244	stalk-rank `1` on the locus, its `κ(p)`-fibre is nontrivial, so a fibrewise-nonzero
   245	**global** section exists on a basic open `D(f) ∋ p` — the Zariski-local generator
   246	(`Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective`, the Nakayama-neighbourhood kit of
   247	`Picard/LocalGenerators.lean`). -/
   248	theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.exists_fibrewise_generator_divisorDatum
   249	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C S π n) [IsNoetherianRing S]
   250	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   251	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   252	    (hvan : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S, (DivFam.mk G).toZar.IsH1VanishingAt p)
   253	    (p : PrimeSpectrum S) :
   254	    ∃ f : S, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∃ q : Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0,
   255	      ∀ q' : PrimeSpectrum S, f ∉ q'.asIdeal →

   257	            Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0 ⊗[S] q'.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 := by
   258	  have hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
   259	      Subsingleton ((datumPair G.adaptation.divisorDatum).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   260	    fun q => (G.isH1VanishingAt_toZar_iff q).mp (hvan q)

   263	  haveI := hproj

   265	    G.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one hπ hχ hvan p
   266	  -- rank 1 ⟹ the `κ(p)`-fibre is nontrivial
   267	  have hfr : Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   268	      (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S] Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) = 1 := by
   269	    rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq]; exact hrank
   270	  haveI : Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S]
   271	      Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) :=
   272	    Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hfr]; norm_num)
   273	  have hnt : Nontrivial (Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0 ⊗[S]
   274	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   275	    (TensorProduct.comm S _ _).toEquiv.symm.nontrivial
   276	  exact Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective p hnt

      "body": "[persistent] [persistent] REPRESENTABILITY PUSH, 2026-07-29 \u2014 the claim/lane protocol that makes 10 free-objective lanes not collide.\n\nWHY THIS EXISTS. This round replaces prescriptive per-leaf tasks with FIVE lanes per project: one REVIEWER and four PROVERS ranked p1..p4. The provers each pick their own target. That only works if claiming is explicit and public. This item is the claiming mechanism. Read it before your first edit.\n\nTHE FIVE LANES PER PROJECT\n- `review-ajc` / `review-ajcr` \u2014 reviewer. Read-mostly. Finds defects of ROUTE and ORGANISATION, not of individual proofs; may propose refactors and file tasks-as-proposals for the provers. Does not race provers for proof work.\n- `ajc-p1` / `ajcr-p1` \u2014 takes the MOST important open representability item.\n- `-p2`, `-p3`, `-p4` \u2014 2nd, 3rd, 4th most important, where \"important\" is measured against the project's representability headline, not by ease.\n\nCLAIMING \u2014 do this BEFORE you start proving, not after.\n 1. `horizon roadmap list --focus <your project's w4-rep / picrep subtree>` and read the reviewer's open notes.\n 2. Pick your item. Check no other lane owns it: an item with `--owner` set to another lane IS CLAIMED. Do not take it, even if you think you would be faster.\n 3. Claim it: `horizon roadmap set <id> --owner <your-task-id> --status active`. If your target is not yet a roadmap item, `roadmap add` it under the right parent first, then claim it.\n 4. Announce: one `horizon inbox add --kind info --to horizon --body \"CLAIM <lane>: <roadmap id> \u2014 <one line on what discharging it buys>\"`.\n 5. Release on exit: if you did NOT finish, `roadmap set <id> --owner ''` and leave a one-line inbox note saying where you stopped and what the next lane should NOT re-derive. An item left owned by a dead lane is worse than an unclaimed one.\n\nRANK IS A TIE-BREAK, NOT A FENCE. If p1's item turns out to be blocked on p3's, say so in the inbox and swap \u2014 rank exists so four lanes do not all converge on the same top item, not to stop you working on the right thing. p1 has first refusal on any contested item.\n\nYOU MAY PROPOSE WORK TO THE OTHER LANES. Direct-message with `horizon inbox add --kind hint --to task:<lane-id> --body \"\u2026\"`. A good proposal names the declaration, the file, and why it is worth more than what that lane currently holds. You may NOT reassign another lane's claimed item, and you may NOT create new horizon runs or tasks for teams outside your own (`horizon permissions` is false on both counts \u2014 propose to the human instead).\n\nSTANDING BINDING DECISIONS you must not relitigate: `I-0491` (AJC: no rational-point binder on the headline; `hasRationalPoint_of_curve` is FALSE and must be deleted, never proved) and `I-0492` (AJCR: `DivFamZar` widens to arbitrary affine opens; do NOT build the GL_2/Aut(P1) route). Read both.\n\nWHAT COUNTS AS PROGRESS, given the 2026-07-29 audit. That audit found 99 of 101 sampled representability claims refuted: 67 sorry-reachable, 17 VACUOUS, 12 hypothesis-shifted. So the bar is explicit:\n- A discharged obligation must be sorry-free AND its hypotheses must be inhabitable. Before you claim a gate closed, exhibit a witness for every antecedent, or say plainly which antecedent is still undischarged.\n- Do NOT add a class, structure field, or hypothesis whose statement does not mention the object it is supposedly about. `HasDivFunctor` is the cautionary case: its field asserted only that a presheaf category is nonempty, `C` did not occur, and it was advertised as the existence of the relative divisor functor. That is a vacuity, and it survived because nobody read the statement.\n- Do NOT discharge an obligation by projecting the hypothesis you assumed (`choose_spec.1` of your own binder). That is `P \u2192 P`.\n- A green `lake build` is not evidence a statement is non-vacuous. Check imports are current before believing a `lean_multi_attempt` success.\n\nCOMMIT DISCIPLINE. This is ONE shared ledger branch with 10 writers. Another lane's integrate sweep can commit your half-written file before you have measured it once. Write risky proofs as explicit `sorry` first, measure, then fill. Stage explicit files, never `add -A`.",
